runwick <command> [options]   (runwick --agent describe for the machine-readable list)

  context add              Save a context: server URL, login method, user and the name of the secret's environment variable.

  context show             Show the current context (never a secret value).

  jobs list                List jobs, newest first.
  jobs get                 Show a job with its generations and attempts (no payload).
  jobs tail                Follow a job until it ends: one item per state or revision change.
  jobs cancel              Cancel a job (a running job gets a cancel request).
  jobs retry               Retry a failed or cancelled job as a new generation.
  jobs rerun               Run a succeeded job again as a new generation.
  jobs cancel-many         Cancel up to 100 jobs listed as JSON Lines {jobId, expectedGeneration, expectedRevision}.
  jobs reveal-payload      Show a job's payload; the server writes an audit row.
  jobs reveal-error        Show an attempt's error; the server writes an audit row.
  dispatch                 Create a job of a registered job type from a JSON payload (file or stdin); audited.
  queues list              List queues.
  queues pause             Pause a queue (stops new reservations).
  queues resume            Resume a paused queue.
  workers list             List worker instances.
  capacity list            List concurrency scopes.
  capacity set             Set a scope's capacity.
  schedules list           List schedules.
  schedules pause          Pause a schedule.
  schedules resume         Resume a schedule (--policy skipPaused|runOnce|catchUp).
  schedules trigger        Run a schedule now; the command ID is the trigger ID.
  schedules revalidate     Revalidate a schedule that needs review.
  events tail              Read job
